dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Barbara and Miss Nilou have nothing but high praise for Mualani's Mondstadt-Natlan fusion food. If you're tired or hungry, you should definitely try it!

choices.text: I'm doing great! How about you?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I, well...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I'm kinda excited, actually.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Excited?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Well, I've never really talked about dancing with friends from abroad before... Definitely not with two friends who're this amazing!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Mualani told me all about Miss Nilou beforehand, so I knew what to expect.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Speaking with her feels like you're listening to a lullaby...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Err, not in the sense that you'd fall asleep, but more... that your body and mind get so relaxed...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: She's slow, gentle, calm, and so reassuring...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Haha, I knew I was on to something!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: And then there's Miss Barbara. I was honestly a bit worried before meeting her...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: After all, I've heard that she's Mondstadt's most popular idol. That makes her a superstar, right?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: So I was thinking, would I upset her if I mess up in some way?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Luckily, she turned out to be super easygoing as well.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Her vibe is a bit different from Nilou's. She feels more like a... bubble?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Light, floaty, and shiny! That's the feeling she gives off.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Honestly, I didn't think I'd ever meet two more girls like Mualani.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Y'know, people who could roll with every dance move I suggested on the first try!

choices.text: Sounds like you've met your people, eh?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Totally! I'll treasure this time we have for sure!

choices.text: Make sure to hang out with them more, alright?
And how are you getting along with them?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I... I realized that the two of them would mention all these techniques that I've never considered before...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: In terms of time spent dancing and the number of performances they've done... Both are way ahead of me.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Though our dancing styles are different, I really want to learn from them and pick up new techniques.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: You've always taught me to push my limits and become a more well-rounded person...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: You never said it directly, but I've heard adventurers from all over say that you can solve just about any problem.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: They also say that when it comes to... uh, academic qualifications, you would be rated as an expert in many different areas of study by artisans from Liyue, as well as academics from both the Sumeru Akademiya and that Institute thing in Fontaine...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: And isn't there a saying in Liyue about "leading by example"? Well, I think you are doing just that!

choices.text: You've been learning a lot lately, Kachina!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Haha, thanks! I'll do my best too!

choices.text: Looks like we'll have to push ourselves more from now on, too!
Huh. Strange, don't recall saying that.
I'll take a break first before continuing.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: O—Okay! Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
